args.message: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, contradicting its own docstring and the FIN-212 requirement of banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), which caused `tests/test_money.py` to fail on the nightly build (e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Change
- Switch the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed (`tests/test_money.py` green).

transcript.reasoning_content: Fix: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN. 2.675 quantized to 0.01 with ROUND_HALF_EVEN: 2.675 exact decimal -> 2.68 (7 is odd, round up to 8)? ROUND_HALF_EVEN rounds to even digit: 2.675 -> tie between 2.67 and 2.68; last digit of 2.68 is 8 (even) -> 2.68. 2.665 -> tie between 2.66 and 2.67; 6 even -> 2.66. Correct.
